description: This file defines a PHP class for Bezier curve smoothing in a graph plotting library, including methods for calculating control points and adjusting Y-axis bounds.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Bezier
classes.description: A class for creating Bezier smoothed plots within the Image_Graph library, extending the base plot class.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Bezier
methods.description: Constructor for the Bezier smoothed plot class, initializes with dataset and title.

methods.name: _minimumY
methods.description: Returns the minimum Y value, scaled slightly upward.

methods.name: _maximumY
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y value, scaled slightly upward.

methods.name: _getControlPoints
methods.description: Calculates control points for Bezier curves based on neighboring data points.

methods.name: _addSamplePoints
methods.description: Creates sample data points for the plot legend, using a sine wave pattern.
